faqs.q: Where can I find general information about iCare (Insurance and Care NSW)?
faqs.a: You can visit the main iCare website for general information.

faqs.q: What schemes are covered by iCare?
faqs.a: iCare covers various schemes, including CTP Care, Dust Diseases Care, Home Building Compensation Fund (HBCF), Insurance for NSW, Lifetime Care and Support Scheme, Sporting Injuries Insurance Scheme, and Workers Insurance and Workers Care Program.

faqs.q: How can I contact iCare for assistance?
faqs.a: You can find contact details on the dedicated iCare contact page.
